meta.model_file: bi_lstm_top200_xform_16qtr.keras (saved 12-Dec-2025) with its label encoder and StandardScaler
meta.training: Supporting workbook Train rows: 64 quarters, 31-Mar-2005 to 31-Dec-2020, 39,716 stock-quarters, top-200 next-quarter-return label. Transforms fitted on those rows only.
meta.out_of_sample: 21 quarters scored 31-Mar-2021 to 31-Mar-2026, every one after the training cut-off.
meta.price_convention: Each scoring quarter is held from the month-end two months after the quarter-end to the month-end five months after it (60-day reporting lag), e.g. the 31-Mar-2021 row is held 31-May-2021 to 31-Aug-2021. Stock prices are the lagged prices recorded in the supporting workbook; index levels are NSE daily closes on the same dates.
meta.portfolio: Top N by model rank, equal weight, rebalanced each quarter; price returns, no dividends, costs or slippage.
meta.in_sample_note: Quarters up to and including 31-Dec-2020 were in the training data of every model shown; their returns are flattered because the models have seen those outcomes. Use them to see how a model fits history, not to judge skill.
meta.benchmark_note: nifty50/quality30/momentum30/value30 are NIFTY index price returns on the same lagged dates; universe_ew is the equal-weight average of every scored stock with prices.
meta.comparison_note: Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM are fitted (seed 42) on the same 64 training quarters and the same transformed features as the BiLSTM, and scored on the same quarters, so every series in the model selector covers identical dates and the benchmark figures do not change with the model chosen. The momentum and random rankings are references, not models.
meta.reproducibility: score_all.py then build_site.py (published with the Playbook) regenerate every number on this page from the model files and the supporting workbook.
